description: Company Filing Monitor for SEC EDGAR — Monitor up to 15 SEC companies by ticker or CIK. Get recent filings and amendments, original filing links, and a timestamp for your next check. Use a saved Apify task for recurring digests or pass the timestamp from the prior complete run.

companies.description: SEC tickers or CIKs, such as AAPL and 0000789019.

forms.description: Optional SEC form filter, such as 10-K, 10-Q or 8-K. Includes amendments of selected forms.

lookback_days.description: Lookback window in whole days. Defaults to 7 when since is absent.

since.description: Exclusive UTC timestamp ending in Z. Use next_since from a complete result.

name: company-filing-monitor
